description: This source file implements a fuzzing test harness for Android gralloc types, including functions to process input data, fill metadata, and invoke decoding functions for testing purposes.

methods.name: doFuzz
methods.description: Performs fuzzing by selecting a decode function based on instruction and applying it to input data.

methods.name: fillInMetadataType
methods.description: Fills a MetadataType structure from input bytes, extracting value and name.

methods.name: doFuzzVendorHelper
methods.description: Performs vendor-specific fuzzing using decoded metadata and input data.

methods.name: fuzz
methods.description: Main dispatch function that chooses between different fuzzing strategies based on options.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: Entry point for the fuzzing engine, processes input data and triggers fuzzing functions.
